name: minecraft-helper
description: Ask the guide: a voice-first Minecraft (Bedrock) helper that works offline.

scripts.build: node tools/build-book.mjs && node tools/join-guides.mjs && node tools/join-builds.mjs && node tools/check-links.mjs && node tools/make-icons.mjs && node tools/build-old-safari.mjs && node tools/stamp-sw.mjs
scripts.build:guides: node tools/join-guides.mjs && node tools/check-links.mjs && node tools/build-old-safari.mjs && node tools/stamp-sw.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:unit && playwright test --config playwright.config.mjs tests/e2e --project=desktop-chrome
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:mutation && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:perf && npm run test:lighthouse
